label: very long ticket
message: OK so here is what happened, in order, because I want to be useful. I opened the site on my work laptop, which is a 2019 MacBook with the screen set to a weird scaled resolution because of my eyes. I pasted a script that I wrote last week for testing our onboarding flow. It has about eight tasks and a short intro. I pressed Poke it and the loading animation played, which was nice, and then the grade came up. But the grade panel looked squished, like the three colored sections were overlapping each other slightly, and the text in the middle section was running into the one below it. I thought maybe it was my zoom level so I reset the zoom with command zero, and it got a little better but the badge was still too close to the summary. Then I tried to chat with POKE about the weaknesses and I typed a long question about whether my second task was leading. The reply came back fine but when I scrolled up in the panel the first message had a weird gap above it. Then I resized the window narrower to see if it would fix itself and the whole thing jumped. After that I refreshed and of course lost my grade because there is no way to get it back, which I guess is expected but I was annoyed because I had not copied the weaknesses anywhere. I tried again with the same script and this time the layout was fine, so I honestly cannot tell you if it is a real bug or something about my first load. Browser is Chrome, latest version, I think. Sorry this is so long.
